from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialAsset(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported transactional financial assets from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this report belongs to")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The company's stock/certificate code if available")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g. '2024年第一'')")
    transactional_financial_assets: float | None = Field(description="The transactional financial assets amount if reported; None if not mentioned")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_assets: list[CompanyFinancialAsset]
